**Area:** [Media](../COVERAGE.md#media) · **Apple:** [AVFoundation](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/avfoundation) · **Issues:** [`area:media`](https://github.com/kolabs-dev/isim/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Aarea%3Amedia)

## How isim implements it

- **Passthrough:** ffmpeg / ffprobe child processes (decoding, export, camera), libavcodec (AAC), espeak-ng (speech), zbar / zxing-cpp (codes).
- **Adapted:** isim's real-time audio graph and DSP (`AVAudioEngine.swift`) on an SDL3 mixer (`isim/runtime/host_audio.c`).
- **Simulated hardware:** `ISIM_CAMERA` (an image, a video or a v4l2 webcam), `ISIM_AUDIO_INPUT`, `ISIM_CAMERA_DEPTH`.
